decisions.reason: The 12-hour delivery ultimatum changes the deadline but does not change the required creative concept or reference strategy.
The source changes delivery timing and its consequence without changing any required keywords, claims, or script messaging.
The delivery ultimatum does not resolve or alter the requested audio level, mixing standard, or existing ambiguity.
The shortened delivery window does not alter the conversion objective, CPL target, or priority of conversion performance over aesthetics.
The source imposes a final delivery deadline but does not revise the preview duration, language, content, or approval workflow.
The deadline change does not modify the required visual realism, prohibited production methods, or unresolved production-method ambiguity.
